feedback: Kassundi, your introduction is clear, but your project explanation could be more structured and detailed. You mentioned a specific project, the inventory tracking dashboard, but could elaborate more on your role and the technical skills you applied to resolve the data mismatch issue.
suggestions: Practice explaining technical projects in a step-by-step manner
Use more professional terms like 'data inconsistency' instead of 'data mismatch'

better_answer_example: In my final year project, I developed an inventory tracking dashboard using Java, Spring, and MySQL. I was responsible for designing and implementing the stock update reports and dashboard visualizations. One of the key challenges we faced was data inconsistency between the reports and stock records. I worked closely with my team to identify the root cause and implemented a data validation mechanism to ensure data accuracy. Through this project, I not only improved my technical skills in Java and MySQL but also enhanced my collaboration and problem-solving skills.
